background-color: #ff5a00; } .switch { --switch-bg: #ff5a00; } Jobs > Junior Compliance Counsel Junior Compliance Counsel Indefinite Full time Hybrid (Barcelona, Spain) Legal About FunPlus FunPlus is one of the largest privately held companies in all of gaming. Founded in 2010, it is a global creator of interactive entertainment experiences powered by technology, with cross-platform game development and IP crea
items.requirements: tion at its core. FunPlus is an organization that fosters top industry talent, with around 2,000 team members based in offices and studios across the world. These talented creative teams are well-known for developing hugely popular cross-platform titles, including DC: Dark Legion , State of Survival , King of Avalon , Guns of Glory , Stormshot , Sea of Conquest , Misty Continent , Tiles Survive! , Foundation: Galactic Frontier , and Aniimo . Please visit www.funplus.com to find out more and follow us on LinkedIn , Instagram , Facebook , , and X for the latest news and career opportunities . Your Role We're looking for a bright, hands-on Junior Counsel to join our Legal West team and support us primarily across game compliance, privacy and AI governance matters. If you've completed your legal training at a top university in Europe, the UK, or the US - and you have proven to thrive in fast-paced, creative environments - this could be your next career move. You'll provide pragmatic legal support to a global, cross-functional team and help our studios navigate game compliance, data privacy and the fast-moving world of AI regulation, in one of the most dynamic sectors on the planet: video gaming. This role reports to our General Counsel, supports amongst others our Swiss Compliance Counsel and works closely with our business teams and other legal professionals across Switzerland, Portugal, Spain, and China. Responsibilities Support game compliance projects and reviews through the entire game life cycle (a.o. testing, launches, new features, live operations events, monetisation mechanics and platform submissions), working closely with Product, UA and Live Ops teams. Support the AI governance chapter, including reviewing the use of generative AI and machine learning tools in game development, marketing and player-facing features, and helping maintain our AI compliance framework as regulation evolves (EU AI Act and equivalent regimes). Provide day-to-day support on data privacy matters, including data processing agreements, data protection impact assessments, privacy notices, cookie and consent frameworks, data subject request handling, and vendor privacy matters across all Western jurisdictions. Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements including vendor, marketing, and KOL agreements. Help maintain and evolve our policies, guidelines and template library and playbooks for recurring game compliance, privacy and AI questions and matters. Track regulatory developments relevant to gaming, privacy and AI in Western markets and summarise practical implications for the business in plain language (including training). Collaborate cross-functionally with business, HR, marketing, and tech teams. Requirements Approx. 3 years' experience in a legal role, ideall
